questions: Panels to the UCON survey (wall A {{@s['walls'][0]['L']}}, wall B {{@s['walls'][1]['L']}}, ceiling {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}} above the subfloor). Sizes per A-701 replace your 252137 rev 2. Numbers: P01-P13 = your wall A panels 1-13; P14-P20 = the backs of your bookcase (wall B); P21-P32 = the niche linings (new - your rev 2 shows 'finished panels'). Please confirm.

Heights as our other AP rooms, from the subfloor, finished floor +{{ffl}}: NO stone plinth in the office - all panels start 10 above the finished floor ({{z0('P09')}}) and stop 10 under the ceiling ({{z1('P01')}}). One horizontal joint {{z1('P09')}} / {{z0('P01')}} all round = the niche soffit face: lower panels {{h('P09')}}, upper {{h('P01')}} (your rev 2: 2390 / 1246). Joints 10 open. Please confirm.

The three niches as PORTALS: the side panels are returns at the edges of your base units, mitred 45 to the front panels (P10 / P11 / P12 / P13, P02 / P04 / P06 / P08) and to the niche soffits P24 / P28 / P32; the soffits mitred 45 to the panels over the niches (P03 / P05 / P07). Three-way corners per A-511 / A-512. Please confirm you can make the mitres (long point on the face).

Fixing of the returns: N2 (P25 / P27): frame 19 on wood blocks 2x4 flat ({{-@s['walls'][6]['build_up']['recess']}}) between the frame and the drywall + clip; N1 / N3 (P21 / P23, P29 / P31) only {{@s['walls'][2]['build_up']['face']}} / {{@s['walls'][10]['build_up']['face']}} from the niche wall to the base edge, so the frame 19 is sunk {{@s['walls'][2]['build_up']['recess']}} / {{@s['walls'][10]['build_up']['recess']}} into the wall - the INSTALLER removes the drywall under the frame, or fixes the frame directly on the drywall where the site allows. Please confirm.
The niche soffits P24 / P28 / P32 hang on clips from frames on the niche head (face down). Please confirm the clip type is suitable overhead, or propose a fixing.

Wall A base units, centred in the niches: N1 / N3 450, N2 450 + 1200 + 450 (d.35 in the 331 niche, fronts flush with the panels). The cabinet SIZES are taken from your drawings (rev 2); the FINAL CONFIGURATION is yours - handles / gola, front sizes, drawers, interiors are not by UCON, drawn for general understanding. The fronts are LOWERED to the panel level: they cover the plinth and stop 10 above the finished floor. Please confirm.
Countertops in the niches: 60 BY OTHERS (drawn see-through), top {{z0('P22')}}; the niche backs P22 / P26 / P30 stand on them. To be confirmed by the GC / stone supplier.

Bookcase (wall B), your modules 670 kept, reworked to the survey: end fillers 47.7 / 28 (your 100), split at the room joint {{z1('P09')}} / {{z0('P01')}}; outer sides split at the counter top; inner uprights on the counter; roof board in three pieces (left bookcase / over the door / right bookcase); depth 442 from the wall; door unit 900 x 2746.85 x 442 (your 889 x 2771) to the opening 900 x 2824. Please confirm.

Bookcase backs P14-P20 are part of the bookcase (no backing frame on wall B): MDF 22 at the wall, between the uprights, counter top to the roof board. PAINT ALLOWANCE on the parts that fit tight BETWEEN the uprights (the backs and the shelves): we give the FINISHED size = bay - 1 (0.5 each side), e.g. bay 655 -> part 654, bay 640 -> 639, over the door 900 -> 899 - on a previous job the thick paint made the shelves not fit. Wall panels (joints 10), fronts (joints 3) and the mitred niche portals get no allowance. If your sizes already include a paint allowance, tell us - we will issue the bay sizes instead. Please confirm.

Bookcase base units: hinged doors 667 (no pull-outs), handle-less with a gola 30 at the top, cut to the panel level (bottom 10 above the finished floor). Hinges, seen from the room: left bookcase L / L / R, right bookcase L / R / R; the door unit in the middle hinged left (push to open). Please confirm.
Long panels in one piece: the tallest are the returns {{h('P21')}}, the lower wall panels {{h('P09')}} and the bookcase backs {{h('P14')}}. Please confirm your maximum panel length.

Panels hang on {{@s['clips']['make']}} clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). All drilling coordinates from the panel BACK (X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge) - please confirm before drilling.
We have your office drawing only as a PDF (252137 rev 2, 2026-02-24, 'office modifiche del 30-01-2026'). Please send the DWG.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the top of the subfloor (finished floor +{{ffl}}). Dimensions per UCON survey govern; the design of TM 252137 rev 2 (PDF) is kept and fitted to the survey (Q1, Q13).

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM (ROVERE SBIANCATO RIGATINO); joints 10 open; 10 above the finished floor, 10 under the ceiling, no stone plinth (Q2). Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}; inside corners: the long wall runs through.

Niches: PORTALS - returns at the base edges, back on the countertop, soffit; all corners mitred 45 (Q3, A-511 / A-512). Returns N1 / N3: frame sunk into the niche wall - the INSTALLER removes the drywall under the frame or fixes on the drywall (Q4).

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703). Clips {{@s['clips']['make']}}, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes by UCON CNC.

PAINT ALLOWANCE: only the lacquered parts that fit tight BETWEEN the bookcase uprights - the backs P14-P20 and the shelves - are given at the FINISHED size = bay - 1 (0.5 each side); the bay size is shown next to them in red. Not for wall panels (joints 10), fronts (joints 3), mitred portals. If TM's sizes already include an allowance, the bay sizes are issued instead (Q9).

TM furniture (bases, bookcase, door unit) and the countertop BY OTHERS: the cabinet sizes are taken from the factory drawings (TM 252137 rev 2); the FINAL CONFIGURATION is determined by the factory, not by UCON - drawn for general understanding. FRONTS: lowered to the panel level - they cover the plinth and stop 10 above the finished floor ({{z0('P09')}}), the same line as the panels. Q6 - Q10.
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.
